heroSubtitle: I make product and learning ideas move: explainer videos, UI motion and social cuts that stay legible on a phone. Storyboard to the files your team ships — in English or Persian.
aboutText:
I animate things that have to *explain* something: a feature nobody understands yet, a course module, an onboarding step.

Since 2018 I have worked on both sides of that job — four years and nine months producing e-learning content at Mehr-e-Alborz University, and since 2023 motion graphics in production at Rahavard Samanehaye Amn in Tehran. I studied software engineering and I am finishing a master's in English language education, which is why briefs, storyboards and review calls do not need a translator in the middle.

I work in After Effects, Photoshop and Premiere Pro. Send the goal and the deadline; you get an honest answer about what is realistic, a scope and a price before anything starts.
aboutSkills: Explainer Videos, UI Animation, Social Cuts, Storyboarding, After Effects
footerNote: Freelance motion designer · Rasht, Iran · open to remote work
servicesIntro: Three ways I help teams get motion shipped — each one starts with a clear scope, not a pitch.

services.title: Explainer Videos
services.desc: Script shaping, storyboard, then a finished product animation — delivered in the aspect ratios you need (16:9, 1:1, 9:16).

services.title: Social Content
services.desc: Short, legible animations built for Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok: strong first frame, readable captions, correct safe areas.

services.title: UI Animation
services.desc: Transitions, onboarding moments and empty states for apps and websites — delivered in the format your developers prefer.
